newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan army captures rebel stronghold.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan army captures rebel stronghold.

text.p: Sri Lankan security forces have captured the Tamil Tigers' northern stronghold of Kilinochchi, the last major town under rebel control, a military spokesman said on Sunday.
"Troops captured the entire township of Kilinochchi at 1630 hours (1000 GMT) today," the spokesman said.
"Clearing operations are in progress and the troops are consolidating in Kilinochchi."

Military officials said the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils, set up base in the town in April after the army captured the northern Jaffna peninsula, which the Tigers had ruled for almost a decade.
The military last Sunday launched its first major push for more than a month after digging in north of Kilinochchi.
